import sys

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) < 2:
        continue
    length = int(parts[0])
    s = parts[1]
    inside = False
    wordsCount = 0
    maxWord = ""
    tempWord = ""
    canCount = True
    for i in range(length):
        c = s[i]
        if c == '(':
            inside = True
            canCount = True
            tempWord = ""
        elif c == ')':
            inside = False
            tempWord = ""
        else:
            if not inside:
                if c == '_':
                    tempWord = ""
                else:
                    tempWord += c
                if len(tempWord) > len(maxWord):
                    maxWord = tempWord
            else:
                if c == '_':
                    canCount = True
                else:
                    if canCount:
                        wordsCount += 1
                        canCount = False
    print(f"{len(maxWord)} {wordsCount}")
